assumed_mechanisms.price: Independent weekly Bernoulli events. Magnitude and sign mix are representative academic decompositions, not an estimated joint law. Monthly billing uses only events available at month opening.
assumed_mechanisms.store: Cycle p10,p50,p90 across own store IDs, normalize mean to one. Scenario assignment, not identified local store factors.
assumed_mechanisms.calendar: beta=log1p(reference amplitude p50), positive exp(beta*sin(month phase)), normalized across twelve months. Assumed link, not a fitted seasonality law.
assumed_mechanisms.burst: Forced coverage cycle NONE,NONE,P95,NONE,P99,NONE. Multiplier applies to synthetic retail requested counts only. Not a natural frequency or wholesale label.
assumed_mechanisms.price_demand_effect: No causal price response applied. Elasticity not identified.
assumed_mechanisms.stock_fx_cost_wholesale: Inherited academic 2.1 physical and commercial assumptions, not estimated from M5/Favorita.

economic_violation_policy: Reject incompatible synthetic price/cost path with PRICE_RULE. No silent flooring, alteration of supplier costs or administrative exception. Future full-build gate must check all paths.
fixture_scope: Only reduced in-memory fixtures in this implementation stage. No catalogue-wide simulation or files under data.
